calls.reason: The 2022 STRIVE paper supports edge cases remaining a central challenge, while Waymo documents substantial work in 2015. This mixed record does not settle when the industry appreciated the problem's severity.

Google describes narrow capabilities, while Stretch and Astro document purchasable or announced robots with limited household functions. These sources establish neither a general household helper nor its market-wide absence.

The Transformer verification and autoformalization papers show restricted integrations, but neither establishes comparable engineering assurance. The qualified claim about an obvious route remains unclear on this evidence.
